<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000">
  <text x="500" y="35" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="25" fill="#17202a">Steady 2D heat conduction — unit square plate</text>

  <rect x="100" y="100" width="800" height="800" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#17202a" stroke-width="3"/>

  <text x="500" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#17202a">y = 1: insulated, ∂T/∂y = 0</text>
  <text x="500" y="929" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#17202a">y = 0: insulated, ∂T/∂y = 0</text>
  <text x="62" y="500" transform="rotate(-90 62 500)" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#17202a">x = 0: T = 100 °C; inward heat flux = 50 W/m²</text>
  <text x="941" y="500" transform="rotate(90 941 500)" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#17202a">x = 1: T = 0 °C</text>

  <text x="118" y="130" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#536171">(0, 1)</text>
  <text x="882" y="130" text-anchor="end" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#536171">(1, 1)</text>
  <text x="118" y="882" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#536171">(0, 0)</text>
  <text x="882" y="882" text-anchor="end" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#536171">(1, 0)</text>

  <text x="500" y="205" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="23" fill="#17202a">∇²T = 0</text>
  <text x="500" y="243" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#17202a">k = 1 W/(m K)</text>

  <g data-field="T" data-status="ill-posed">
    <text x="500" y="355" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="bold" fill="#a12622">Incompatible boundary conditions</text>
    <text x="500" y="400" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#17202a">No steady harmonic temperature field satisfies all conditions.</text>

    <text x="500" y="470" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#17202a">The two edge temperatures and insulated top and bottom</text>
    <text x="500" y="501" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="19" fill="#17202a">uniquely require T(x, y) = 100(1 − x) °C.</text>
    <text x="500" y="552" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="21" fill="#a12622">At x = 0: q_in = −k ∂T/∂x = 100 W/m² ≠ 50 W/m²</text>

    <text x="500" y="635" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#17202a">Requested isotherms: 20, 40, 60 and 80 °C</text>
    <text x="500" y="674" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#a12622">Not drawn: no contours can satisfy every stated condition.</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="100" y1="943" x2="100" y2="978" stroke="#536171" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="900" y1="943" x2="900" y2="978" stroke="#536171" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="962" x2="900" y2="962" stroke="#536171" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M 107,955 L 93,969 M 907,955 L 893,969" fill="none" stroke="#536171" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="500" y="990" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#17202a">1 m × 1 m plate</text>
</svg>
